pr.title: Count a drawer's actions down from 9, and ask before a dismiss
pr.head: aaa7e46109b5d974318def0a8d0494c739c2ff62

summary: Projector's band is a panel above the Claude Code prompt that lists your pull requests and your agents' questions and notices. Pressing an item's line opens its drawer: the item's detail, a question's options, and action lines such as discuss, dismiss, and snooze. Options already took the digits 1 to 6, which work both while the band holds the keyboard and when typed first into an empty prompt. The actions took the letters d, x, and s, which work only from the band.

This pull request gives the actions digits too, counting down from 9: 7 discusses, 8 dismisses or restores, and 9 snoozes or unsnoozes. A digit that works from the prompt makes a stray dismiss easy, so dismiss now asks first: 8: yes, dismiss question and 9: no, keep it. While snooze asks how long, its four lengths take 1 to 4 in place of the hidden options, with 9: cancel.

One atom, bandAsked, records which question an open drawer is asking, replacing bandSnoozing. An atom is a small piece of state the Claude Code plugin engine keeps and redraws the band from. The band forgets the question when the drawer closes, when it is answered, and when the item is resolved or snoozed anywhere.

The open item's own line also changes. It drops its - bullet, so the engine's 0: takes its place, and it is no longer inverted. An open question's line reads in the default text color there. The drawer is indented by the width of 0: , so its lines start under the item's text.

cards.title: Review so far
cards.html:
• The first review found that restoring an item dismissed elsewhere brought back a stale dismiss confirmation, so the next 8 dismissed without asking. Fixed: restore clears the question, and forgetAsked clears it whenever the item is resolved or snoozed. That thread is resolved.
  • The current review is clean, with one suggestion: forgetAsked also drops a dismiss confirmation on an item that was already snoozed, at the next store read. It fails safe, since the next 8 asks again.
  • The user has tried the digits from an empty prompt in a live session and kept that behavior.

groups.title: The drawer's digits and its two questions
groups.kicker: How the band draws action lines, the confirmation, and the snooze lengths
intro: All drawer lines now draw through one helper, drawLines, which renders a plain Button with a digit before its label, as 7: discuss question. The action lines, the dismiss confirmation, and the snooze lengths are three lists of the same Line shape, and the drawer picks one of them by what bandAsked holds.

bandAsked is null, or names the open drawer and whether it asks how long to snooze or whether to dismiss. Pressing dismiss or snooze sets it. Picking a length, confirming, keeping, cancelling, restoring, opening or closing a drawer, and anything that closes the drawer through closeDrawer clear it. forgetAsked also clears it when a store read or an action shows the item resolved or snoozed.

The open item's line, at the top of its drawer, has no bullet and no inverse, and an open question's line there takes the default color. DRAWER_INDENT, the width of the 0: the engine draws before that line, indents the drawer under the item's text.

checks.text: The confirmation and the length lines replace lines in place, so a digit from the prompt presses whatever line holds that digit now. That is why dismiss asks on 8 and confirms on 8: a deliberate dismiss is 8 8, and a single stray 8 only asks.

files.note: Replaces the letters with digits, adds the dismiss confirmation for items and pull requests, draws the snooze lengths as keyed lines in the options' place, forgets a stale question, and redraws the open item's line plain with its drawer indented under it.

checks.text: DRAWER_INDENT is computed from CLOSE_HOTKEY, so the indent follows the close key if it ever changes.

forgetAsked runs from replace after each band action and from setItems after each store read. It clears the question once the asked item is resolved or snoozed. It also clears a dismiss confirmation on an item that was already snoozed when you pressed dismiss, at the next store read; a test written for the review shows it, and it fails safe.
ask(key, null) clears the question whatever drawer it names. closeDrawer is the narrower path: it clears the question only when it belongs to the drawer being closed.
The list still marks an open question in permission. At the top of its own drawer the line reads in the default color, and a resolved or snoozed item keeps subtle.

No digit is shared in a drawer. inbox.check caps a question at six choices, so options use at most 1–6. The lengths use 1–4 only while the options are hidden. The actions, the confirmation, and cancel use 7–9. Traced through each state and confirmed by the digitsOf assertions in hooks/band.test.tsx, which pass.
A pull request's drawer gets the same confirmation, with yes, dismiss PR. Dismissing a pull request stops every loop of this session that tracks it.

files.note: Declares the bandAsked atom in place of bandSnoozing.

groups.title: Tests

intro: Each existing test that dismisses an item or a pull request now presses confirm:<id> after dismiss:<id>. New tests pin the action digits and labels, the dismiss confirmation with its ring moves, the snooze lengths on 1 to 4, and a question forgotten once its item is dismissed or snoozed from a terminal. Existing tests now check the open line's colors and the drawer's indent.
